relationships.subject: MRGPRX2
relationships.evidence_quote: These findings strongly suggest that MRGPRX2 signals upstream of TRPV4.

relationships.subject: TRPV4
relationships.evidence_quote: In vitro, histamine, 48/80, and ET-1 produced Ca2+-transients in cultured primary keratinocytes that were TRPV4-dependent, and Ca2+ influx via TRPV4 increased phosphorylation of extracellular signal-regulated kinase (p-ERK) in keratinocytes (Chen et al., 2016).

relationships.subject: epidermal keratinocytes
relationships.evidence_quote: In the skin-specific TRPV4 cKO animals, scratching behaviors were significantly attenuated in all histaminergic pruritogens tested but not chloroquine, suggesting a role for keratinocytic TRPV4 in histaminergic itch (Chen et al., 2016).

key_findings: Review: TRPV4 in skin keratinocytes, mast cells, macrophages and sensory neurons regulates barrier integrity, nociception and itch.
Keratinocyte and sensory neuron TRPV4 contribute to histaminergic itch via ERK signaling.
